rows.grounds: absolutive of kṣip, indicating a prior act of placing or inserting
ca as connective particle; ādau as initial position in the ritual sequence
the goddess or principle Śrī, taken as object of placement
purpose of freeing from the previously mentioned mantra defect

items.question: What initial placement of Śrī secures liberation from the mantra's defect?
premises: The practitioner has already been instructed to recite the mantra for pacification of its defect.
Placing Śrī at the beginning is prescribed as an additional act.
This placement is directed toward liberation from that same defect.
items.inference: Therefore, invoking Śrī at the outset functions as a means to remove the mantra's defect.
uncertainties: The exact ritual manner of placing Śrī is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: And having placed Śrī at the beginning as well, one does so for liberation from that defect.
